item.title: The US attack on an Iranian warship did not violate international law, experts say
item.description: At least 87 people died and 32 Iranian sailors were rescued after the sub torpedoed the Dena in international waters near Sri Lanka.

item.title: Man arrested after flamingo allegedly abducted and abused at Las Vegas hotel
item.description: CCTV footage showed a man grabbing the bird roughly by the neck at the Flamingo Hotel and Casino.

item.title: Man left bloodied, teeth knocked out after face stomped during road rage attack
